up: List all compounds tested against human cellular tumor antigen p53 (CHEMBL4096) with their canonical SMILES. Return the ChEMBL ID of the compound and the canonical SMILES. Do not deduplicate by compound; return one row per matching activity record.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4096'
